description: APPLICATION FOR A LAWFUL DEVELOPMENT CERTIFICATE IN REPECT OF THE PROPOSED ERECTION OF A HIP TO GABLE AND REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION AND THE ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION
decision_conditions: Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class B) - The operations would comprising a rear dormer and hip to gable consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class B of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class B. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Alteration to the roof of the dwelling house (Class C) - The operations comprising x1 rooflight to the front roofslope would consist of any other alteration to the roof of the dwelling house within the meaning of Class C of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class C. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class A) - The proposed single storey rear extension would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class A of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class A. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.
